findings.title: Default value `timezone.now()` on dataclass field is evaluated only once at import time
findings.body: In `AssignmentSource`, `queued: datetime = timezone.now()` evaluates `timezone.now()` once when the class is defined at module import time. Every `AssignmentSource` instance created without an explicit `queued` argument will receive the same stale timestamp from process startup rather than the time the instance was created. Use `dataclasses.field(default_factory=timezone.now)` instead.

findings.title: `assignment_source` parameter was added to `sync_status_outbound` instead of `sync_assignee_outbound`
findings.body: `IssueSyncIntegration.sync_status_outbound` was updated to take `assignment_source: AssignmentSource | None = None`, but status syncing never uses or passes `assignment_source`. Meanwhile, `src/sentry/integrations/tasks/sync_assignee_outbound.py` passes `assignment_source=parsed_assignment_source` to `installation.sync_assignee_outbound(...)`, whose abstract signature on `IssueSyncIntegration` (line 397) was left without the `assignment_source` parameter.
